notes: Koa has no router; @koa/router is the usual one. await app.callback()(req, res) with stand-in request and response objects. Handlers set ctx.respond = false; on a miss Koa writes its 404 text to the stand-in.
details: Koa itself only runs middleware, so the routes are registered on @koa/router, as in this site's HTTP server task, and its routes() middleware is the application's only middleware. One operation awaits the handler that app.callback() returns, with a minimal request object ({ method, url, headers }) and a stand-in for http.ServerResponse that holds headers in a plain object. Included: Koa's context, request and response objects, on-finished registration, the router's linear scan over 100 path-to-regexp layers, parameter decoding. Handlers set ctx.respond = false, Koa's documented way to leave the response alone; on a miss Koa sets headers and ends the stand-in with its 404 text. @koa/router's synchronous match() is marked private, so there is no entry in hundred-routes.
